import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    static final long P = 1000000007L;

    static class FiniteField {
        private long x;

        public FiniteField(long x) {
            if (x > P || x < 0) {
                System.err.println("Invalied FiniteField!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            this.x = x % P;
            if (this.x < 0) this.x += P;
        }

        public FiniteField() {
            this.x = 0;
        }

        public long Value() {
            return x;
        }

        public FiniteField add(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((this.x + o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField subtract(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((this.x + P - o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField multiply(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((this.x * o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            FiniteField result = new FiniteField(this.x);
            result.divideAssign(o);
            return result;
        }

        public void addAssign(FiniteField o) {
            this.x = (this.x + o.x) % P;
        }

        public void subtractAssign(FiniteField o) {
            this.x = (this.x + P - o.x) % P;
        }

        public void multiplyAssign(FiniteField o) {
            this.x = (this.x * o.x) % P;
        }

        public void divideAssign(FiniteField o) {
            long p = P - 2;
            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1) {
                    this.multiplyAssign(o);
                }
                o.multiplyAssign(o);
                p /= 2;
            }
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int rows;
        int cols;
        FiniteField[][] data;

        public Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            this.rows = rows;
            this.cols = cols;
            this.data = new FiniteField[rows][cols];
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = new FiniteField(0);
                }
            }
        }

        public static Matrix multiply(Matrix a1, Matrix a2) {
            int n = a1.rows;
            int m = a1.cols;
            if (a2.rows != m) {
                System.err.println("Matrix dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            int l = a2.cols;
            Matrix result = new Matrix(n, l);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        result.data[i][j] = result.data[i][j].add(a1.data[i][k].multiply(a2.data[k][j]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static Vector multiply(Matrix matrix, Vector v) {
            int n = matrix.rows;
            int m = matrix.cols;
            if (v.data.length != m) {
                System.err.println("Matrix and vector dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            Vector result = new Vector(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    result.data[i] = result.data[i].add(matrix.data[i][j].multiply(v.data[j]));
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static class Vector {
        FiniteField[] data;

        public Vector(int size) {
            this.data = new FiniteField[size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                data[i] = new FiniteField(0);
            }
        }
    }

    static Matrix make2DMatrix(int d1, int d2, FiniteField defaultValue) {
        Matrix result = new Matrix(d1, d2);
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < d2; j++) {
                result.data[i][j] = defaultValue;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static final int DEBUG = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        int d = scanner.nextInt();

        // shifts[k][i][j]
        FiniteField[][][] shifts = new FiniteField[d][d + 1][d + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                    shifts[k][i][j] = new FiniteField(0);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts[k][i][(i + k) % d] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
            shifts[k][d][d] = new FiniteField(1);
        }

        // units[k][i][j]
        FiniteField[][][] units = new FiniteField[d][d + 1][d + 1];
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                    units[k][i][j] = new FiniteField(0);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units[k][i][i] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units[k][k][i] = new FiniteField(1);
            }
        }

        Matrix identity = make2DMatrix(d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(1));
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            identity.data[i][i] = new FiniteField(1);
        }

        Map<Long, Matrix> cache = new HashMap<>();

        class MatrixFunction {
            public Matrix findMatrix(long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }

                if (p <= d) {
                    Matrix matrix = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                    for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                            matrix.data[i][j] = identity.data[i][j];
                        }
                    }
                    for (int k = 0; k < (int) p; k++) {
                        matrix = Matrix.multiply(units[k], matrix);
                    }
                    cache.put(p, matrix);
                    return matrix;
                }

                long child_p = d;
                while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
                    child_p *= d;
                }
                Matrix child = findMatrix(child_p);
                Matrix matrix = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                        matrix.data[i][j] = child.data[i][j];
                    }
                }
                long remaining_p = p;
                remaining_p -= child_p;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (remaining_p >= child_p) {
                        Matrix shiftsDk = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                            for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                                shiftsDk.data[i][j] = shifts[d - k][i][j];
                            }
                        }
                        Matrix shiftsK = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                            for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                                shiftsK.data[i][j] = shifts[k][i][j];
                            }
                        }
                        matrix = Matrix.multiply(shiftsDk, Matrix.multiply(child, Matrix.multiply(shiftsK, matrix)));
                        remaining_p -= child_p;
                    } else if (remaining_p > 0) {
                        Matrix shiftsDk = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                            for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                                shiftsDk.data[i][j] = shifts[d - k][i][j];
                            }
                        }
                        Matrix shiftsK = new Matrix(d + 1, d + 1);
                        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                            for (int j = 0; j < d + 1; j++) {
                                shiftsK.data[i][j] = shifts[k][i][j];
                            }
                        }
                        matrix = Matrix.multiply(shiftsDk, Matrix.multiply(findMatrix(remaining_p), Matrix.multiply(shiftsK, matrix)));
                        remaining_p = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cache.put(p, matrix);
                return matrix;
            }
        }

        MatrixFunction func = new MatrixFunction();
        Matrix matrix = func.findMatrix(n);

        Vector baseVector = new Vector(d + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            baseVector.data[i] = new FiniteField(0);
        }
        baseVector.data[d] = new FiniteField(1);

        Vector finalVector = Matrix.multiply(matrix, baseVector);

        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            ans = ans.add(finalVector.data[i]);
        }

        System.out.println(ans.Value());
    }
}
